description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing user profiles in a sports live-streaming platform. It utilizes FastAPI for endpoint definitions, SQLAlchemy for database interactions, and Pydantic models for data validation. The functionality includes creating, retrieving, updating, searching, and deleting user profiles, with support for privacy controls and search filters.

methods.name: create_user_profile( profile_data: UserProfileCreate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Creates a new user profile, assigning a user ID if not provided, and checks for existing profiles before insertion.

methods.name: get_my_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves the profile of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: update_my_profile( profile_update: UserProfileUpdate = Body(...), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the profile of the currently authenticated user with provided fields.

methods.name: get_profile_by_id( profile_id: str, request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves a user profile by its profile ID, respecting privacy settings.

methods.name: search_profiles( q: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search query for display name or username"), favorite_sport: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by favorite sport"), location: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by location"), verified_only: bool = Query(False, description="Show only verified profiles"), limit: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of profiles to return"), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of profiles to skip"), request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Searches for user profiles based on query parameters such as username, display name, sports, location, and verification status.

methods.name: delete_my_profile( request: Request = None, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Deletes the profile of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: UserProfileResponse _convert_profile_to_response(profile: UserProfileDB, is_own_profile: bool = False)
methods.description: Converts a database profile object into a Pydantic response model, including optional notification preferences.
